operation.description:
Gets GitHub Actions cache usage for a repository.
The data fetched using this API is refreshed approximately every 5 minutes, so values returned from this endpoint may take at least 5 minutes to get updated.

Anyone with read access to the repository can use this endpoint.

If the repository is private, OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.
operation.summary: Get GitHub Actions cache usage for a repository

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

#/components/schemas/actions-cache-usage.description: GitHub Actions Cache Usage by repository.

active_caches_count.description: The number of active caches in the repository.

active_caches_size_in_bytes.description: The sum of the size in bytes of all the active cache items in the repository.

full_name.description: The repository owner and name for the cache usage being shown.

#/components/schemas/actions-cache-usage.title: Actions Cache Usage by repository
